query:
Two people observe that Adaeze saying 'it's fine' about the Christmas fund has become a recurring pattern and that the issue deserves to be put on the agenda properly. Which of the following made this specific observation — and what in how they expressed it distinguishes their message from the other person who said something similar immediately before?

Options:
A. Obiageli
B. Chisom
C. Nkechi
D. Ifeoma
context:
[1] (about=Chisom, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:31:00) Ada you always say it's fine and it is never fully fine though 😭 I see you
[2] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:25:00) Aunty Oby I appreciate that, genuinely. It's fine for now. Let's just get through this year and we can revisit the setup after. 😊
[3] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:44:00) okay so before we move on I need to say something about the Christmas fund. I love doing this but I genuinely need someone to share this with me this year - I nearly dropped it in November. six years is a long time to be doing the chasing and the reconciling alone. I'm asking properly now, not hinting. who will co-manage it with me from this December?
[4] (about=Chisom, said_by=Adaeze, profile, t8 @2025-11-16T16:22:00) Adaeze brings up the venue deposit, which Kingsley has already booked.
[5] (about=Emeka, said_by=Adaeze, profile, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Adaeze is glad Emeka said it in the chat for once.
[6] (about=Emeka, said_by=Adaeze, profile, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Adaeze notes Emeka's commitment to the Leeds gathering.
[7] (about=Emeka, said_by=Chisom, profile, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Chisom perceives a 'thing' between Emeka and Adaeze regarding Sunday voice notes.
[8] (about=Ifeoma, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:27:00) I think what might help is someone sets a group schedule for Christmas Day so we are not winging it. Last year the video call with Aunty Oby started two hours late because nobody had tested the link.
[9] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:14:00) hear me out, I will do mine this week, I'm just waiting on a payment to clear. On God it's all fine. Adaeze can I send it in two parts this year? 🙏
[10] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:23:00) My children, Ifeoma is right. A standing order would save Adaeze having to send reminders every year. God willing, we should set that up in January. Adaeze, how much do we have so far? Is it enough for the usual gifts and the Christmas day food budget?
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Obiageli, group-interaction, t1 @2025-10-26T15:12:00) Wishing to plan the Christmas gathering properly, Obiageli asks about hosting, contributions, and timeline.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Obiageli, group-interaction, t1 @2025-10-26T15:12:00) Others perceive Obiageli as proactive and concerned about planning ahead for the Christmas gathering.
